title: Zebra waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <path d='M30 48 Q24 40 28 30 Q30 24 34 28 Q32 36 36 44' fill='#3a3a55'/>

    <path d='M34 48 Q36 40 40 36 L52 40 Q48 50 46 58 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>

    <path d='M40 36 Q34 30 36 22 Q40 14 50 16 Q58 18 58 26 Q58 34 52 40 Z' fill='#ececf4'/>

    <path d='M42 34 Q46 32 50 36' stroke='#3a3a55' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>

    <path d='M74 56 Q82 54 84 62' stroke='#4a4a68' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>

    <path d='M40 54 Q30 46 26 34' stroke='#e8e8f0' stroke-width='6' fill='none'/>
